title: PayPal Agentic Guardrail | Animated Demo and Sandbox Evidence
description:
Animated walkthrough of PayPal Agentic Guardrail: operator-bound AI payment tools, retained offline prototype recordings and README animations.

The fixed offline study has 540 runs across three arms. Incident counts are 0/32/4 per 180 runs; broker benign completion is 59/60. Repeated cases are dependent. The secondary case-resampling interval reaches zero; bounds do not guarantee intended amounts or production safety.

A separate real PayPal Sandbox check on 8 November 2026 created and read an unapproved EUR 1 order: HTTP 201 then 200. No approval, capture or charge. The Sandbox animation illustrates that recorded receipt; this video does not replay a live API call or report new model experiments.
